message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r5 -- the standby holder writes REMOTE60_NATIVE_ENCODED_EXPERIMENT_FORCE=1 into its viewer's own environment

The verifier's runs oa-s / oa-p (2026-10-30 00:14) stopped INVALID: the managed viewer the holder started exited
at once with "unsupported codec: h264 (... set env REMOTE60_NATIVE_ENCODED_EXPERIMENT_FORCE=1)" -- the holder
left the viewer's environment to its caller's (ka_pc_managed_e2e_test sets it process-wide; the product shell
sets it before each managed viewer, client_managed_viewers.hpp:149).
- ka_standby_holder_env.hpp: env_block_with() -- the viewer's block gets FORCE=1 and the window seam's X / Y,
  replacing whatever the caller had; the holder logs what its viewer got.
- holder options for the device-free check only: --host-id (no host lookup), --omit-viewer-encoded-env 1
  (negative contrast: launched as r4 did).
- oa_holder_viewer_check.ps1: the REAL holder starts the REAL GNLinkViewerKaTest against a loopback directory
  (ports 18521 / 18522, relay off, no Host); the caller's FORCE removed first. PASS: no codec refusal, up >= 6 s
  after Init, ended after Release. Negative (r4 launch): the refusal and the exit reproduce. Both PASS.
- ka_standby_holder_verdict_test 9/9 (env block cases added).
